Name: Stardew AI Cheats
Author: bts570
Description:
Transform your Stardew Valley experience by connecting the in-game chat box directly to a powerful local Large Language Model (LLM). Instead of memorizing complex console commands, looking up item IDs, or navigating clunky cheat menus, you can just type exactly what you want in plain English.
Whether you need a quick stack of iridium, want to guarantee rain for tomorrow, or need to warp across the map, just ask. The AI instantly understands your natural language request and triggers the exact cheats or in-game actions you need on the fly. Best of all, the entire system runs directly on your own hardware—meaning it's fully local, completely private, 100% free, and completely open source.
